title: Veil and Ember Again
author: K. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Wendell Fairweather, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
